name: codex-agentops
description: Turn-level MLflow observability for standard Codex harness agents

interface.shortDescription: Observe standard Harness Agent turns in MLflow.
interface.longDescription: Captures Codex turn, tool, and subagent hooks plus official OTel token and tool timing, stores them in a local outbox, and uploads complete MLflow traces. Transcript token records are used only as a guarded fallback.
